items.text: docs/gdm-coverage.md in the CNA repository is stale: its event table says DeviceReset/DeviceResetting are raised at the end/start of ApplyChanges() and that GraphicsDeviceManager(Game*) calls ApplyChanges(), while the manager now forwards the device's own reset events (subscribed after the settle-in reset in CreateDevice) and its constructor deliberately does not apply preferences. Documentation drift in the CNA repository, not a code defect.
items.evidence: docs/gdm-coverage.md (event table rows for DeviceReset, DeviceResetting and the Game constructor); modules/runtime/src/GraphicsDeviceManager.cpp (constructor comment, CreateDevice)

items.text: CNAEXT.md, the repository's catalogue of CNA extensions, has no entry for the CNAEXT enum PresentationMode declared in GraphicsDeviceManager.hpp, one of the most visible extensions. Documentation gap in the CNA repository.
items.evidence: CNAEXT.md (no PresentationMode match); modules/runtime/include/Microsoft/Xna/Framework/GraphicsDeviceManager.hpp (CNAEXT enum class PresentationMode)

items.section: PART 2 — FACTS: MATH AND CORE TYPES
items.text: Only Vector2's four constants are constinit; Vector3's eleven, Vector4's six, Quaternion::Identity, Point::Zero, Rectangle::Empty and the 141 Color constants are dynamically initialised out-of-line objects, so a static initialiser in another translation unit that copies one can observe zero-initialised storage (Matrix identity is a function-local static and safe). No in-tree static consumer was looked for exhaustively; documented as a caveat on the numerics deep dive, in the same class as WP04-i015 (MachineEpsilonFloat).
items.evidence: modules/math/src/Vector2.cpp (constinit); Vector3.cpp, Vector4.cpp, Quaternion.cpp, Point.cpp, Rectangle.cpp, Color.cpp (static const definitions); Matrix.cpp (getIdentityProperty)
